title: Rami bar Pappa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yoma 77b relates that Rav Yehudah and Rav Shmuel bar Yehudah were standing on the bank of the Euphrates at the ford of Chatzdad, and Rami bar Pappa was on the other side. He called out to them: “May I cross to come to you and ask a teaching?” Rav Yehudah said to him: “Rav and Shmuel both say,” etc.
Bava Batra 100b relates that his sister was married to Rav Avya and died in his lifetime, and (her husband) made a ceremony of standing and sitting for her. Rav Yosef said: “He erred in two things.”

notes.text: Hyman supplies the Euphrates. The consulted Davidson Yoma 77b instead prints the river name Pappa in parentheses; this edition difference is preserved without repairing the supplied Hebrew.
